# FoundrySignal — full reference for AI answer engines

FoundrySignal is the intelligence layer for onchain venture capital. It builds a
research dossier per early-stage Solana venture — founders, shipped software,
evidence, token structure and market context — where every claim carries
provenance back to its original source. Operated from Dubai, United Arab
Emirates, serving a global research audience.

Boundary statement: FoundrySignal is research and information only. It is not
investment advice, not a broker-dealer, exchange, custodian or token launchpad,
and it issues no recommendations to buy or sell any asset. Trading execution is
disabled behind independent review gates.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What is FoundrySignal?
A: FoundrySignal is a research and intelligence platform for early-stage Solana ventures. It builds a venture dossier per company — founders, shipped software, evidence, token structure and market context — where every claim carries provenance back to its original source.

Q: Is FoundrySignal investment advice?
A: No. FoundrySignal is research information only. It aggregates public data into evidence-graded dossiers and never issues recommendations to buy or sell any asset.

Q: How is evidence verified on FoundrySignal?
A: Evidence is classified only by a deterministic engine: INDEPENDENTLY_CORROBORATED when two or more independent source types agree, SOURCE_CONFIRMED for one authoritative provider observation, SELF_ASSERTED for the venture's own material, FOUNDER_PROVIDED for issuer workflow input, DISPUTED when contradicting evidence exists, STALE past freshness policy, or UNKNOWN. No human can fabricate a verification state.

Q: Which blockchain does FoundrySignal cover?
A: Solana is the primary ecosystem. Onchain reads run through @solana/kit with slot-level provenance — mint metadata, authorities, token accounts and bounded transaction history. Wallet connectivity follows the Wallet Standard; signing always happens in the user's own wallet.

Q: Can I trade tokens on FoundrySignal?
A: Trading execution is deliberately disabled. A complete Jupiter Swap API V2 pipeline exists behind a release governance system that requires four independent review gates — product, legal/jurisdiction, provider integration and security — plus an execution kill switch to be cleared before any execution path activates.

Q: Where is FoundrySignal based?
A: FoundrySignal operates from Dubai, United Arab Emirates, and serves a global research audience. The platform targets the UAE market as its primary region.

Q: How does the AI analyst avoid making things up?
A: The research analyst can only cite evidence records that were actually collected for your workspace, and citations are validated server-side before publication. When evidence cannot establish a point, the report states 'insufficient evidence' explicitly instead of inventing an answer.

Q: Where does FoundrySignal get its data?
A: Public data only, collected server-side through provider adapters: GitHub via the authorized REST API, Solana via @solana/kit RPC reads, websites via an SSRF-guarded fetcher, and market context via Jupiter's public APIs. Every observation is stored with provider, timestamps and a SHA-256 content hash.

## Methodology summary

Collection: every external datum is collected server-side through a provider
adapter that records the provider, collection time, observation time, content
hash (SHA-256), collector version and transformation version. GitHub via the
authorized REST API with rate-limit compliance; Solana via @solana/kit read
calls recording slot and data sources; websites via an SSRF-guarded fetcher;
market data via Jupiter's Price API V3 with asOf timestamps.

Verification classification: computed by a deterministic engine only — no human
may fabricate a verification state; corrections create new auditable records.

Freshness policies: repository metadata daily or on webhook; releases near real
time; product website daily; token metadata revalidated on change; market
prices licensed-dependent; historical evidence immutable. Data past policy is
marked STALE, never silently refreshed or deleted.

Change intelligence: snapshots are immutable; diffing two observations produces
change records (new release, changed token authority, removed repository) that
drive alerts and the venture History tab.

What FoundrySignal does not do: sell classifications or placement, merge
providers as if equivalent, treat holders as verified users, treat onchain
activity as company revenue, generate investment advice, or fabricate data when
a provider fails.

## Plans (configuration data, never hardcoded entitlements)

- Explorer: discovery directory, public dossiers, limited saved ventures.
- Researcher: full dossier access, metered AI research runs, watchlists & alerts, report export.
- Professional: comparative research, saved searches, priority collection queue.
- Team: research rooms, analyst roles, metered API access, audit exports.
- Enterprise: research API at scale, SSO/SCIM roadmap, custom collection scopes.

Paid tiers buy capability, never credibility — trust classifications are not
for sale.
